newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber quiet, consumers seek offers.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber quiet, consumers seek offers.

text.p: Prices of Singapore rubber futures were largely steady on Thursday in thin trade with Goodyear and Bridgestone still seeking offers in the market, dealers said.
"Both Bridgestone and Goodyear were still looking around for offers. But, like yesterday, nothing was done," one dealer said.
The two companies were said to be looking for SIR20 rubber for October/December delivery, the traders said.
The rest of the market was quiet, however, with most buyers sitting on the sidelines.
"Buyers don't feel prices are near the bottom and will wait until they feel it's close to bottoming out," a dealer said.
"The whole market is a bit flat right now," one dealer said. "Demand remains a bit weak." Volume for all rubber grades in the local exchange reached a paltry 3,300 tonnes.
At around 0945 GMT, July RSS3 was seen at 119.50 U.S. cents a kg from 120.50 cents.
July RSS1 was seen at 171.00-173.00 Singapore cents (US$1.19-$1.21) a kg from 173.75 cents.
October/December TSR20 was seen at 116.50 U.S. cents a kg from 117.00 cents. -- (US$1-S$1.43) Rene Pastor (65-8703305)
